class.name: estop_mujoco_plugin/EmergencyStopPlugin
class.description: Provides /emergency_stop (std_srvs/SetBool), the service the real STS hardware interface provides. While active it overrides every actuator command before each physics step: velocity actuators (wheels) get zero, position actuators (pan-tilt) hold the position they had when the stop was enabled. Releasing it hands the commands back to the controllers.
